calm.purpose: Orientation, editorial framing and single-claim communication

standard.purpose: Default marketing, commerce, email and document work

operational.purpose: Inspection, product UI, reports and dense evidence

reading.purpose: Long-form prose, decision copy and focused explanation

standard.purpose: Default page sections, comparisons and two-column work

wide.purpose: Dense ledgers, product families and spatial proofs that earn more columns

policies.baseRhythm: All governed spacing values are integer multiples of the four-pixel base unit; optical exceptions belong to a named future component contract.
policies.contentWidth: Choose reading, standard or wide from the information relationship. A page may move between named widths; it must not invent a fourth container.
policies.responsive: Recompose relationships at named profiles in source order. Viewport width triggers a profile, but content type determines the resulting layout.
policies.density: Calm, standard and operational modes retain the same facts while changing adjacency, padding and evidence concentration for receiver intent.
policies.equalGeometry: Use equal geometry for comparable siblings such as a product family or plan set; do not equalise unlike content merely to make a grid look tidy.
policies.alignmentBreak: A deliberate break may emphasise one dominant object or transition, but reading order, container return and the reason for the break must remain explicit.
policies.contentSafety: Copy expands before type shrinks. No supported viewport may require page-level horizontal scrolling, clipping, content reordering or hidden essential evidence.
policies.channels: Marketing, email, documents and dense interfaces share the spacing source while choosing different content widths and density modes. Cross-channel consistency does not mean identical composition.
